annotation.authors_or_issuer: Câmara dos Deputados; Dep. Julio Lopes
key_provisions_or_claims: Ministry of Health, via the National Secretariat of Digital Health Information, must plan AI use for data management in the SUS.
AI tools must link the history of people with chronic and rare diseases to the CPF.
The SUS number is to be eliminated and the CPF made the single identifier, per Law 14.534/2023.
The plan must set a feasible, transparent and objective implementation deadline.
The justification proposes a reverse auction for an AI tool, with foreign big techs in consortium with national data firms to preserve data sovereignty.
annotation.summary_en: Brazilian bill PL 1522/2024 directs the Ministry of Health to plan the use of AI tools for data management in the Unified Health System (SUS). It would replace the SUS number with the CPF as the single identifier and link chronic and rare disease histories to it. Its justification proposes a reverse auction for the AI tool.
annotation.title_clean: Projeto de Lei nº 1522/2024 - Dispõe sobre a utilização de ferramentas tecnológicas de inteligência artificial para gestão e manutenção de dados no Sistema Único de Saúde em todo território nacional
annotation.title_en: Bill No. 1522/2024 - On the use of artificial intelligence technological tools for data management and maintenance in the Unified Health System nationwide
